attempted_claim: Fix bounded-type theta and the Zakeri slice P^{cm}(theta) of cubic polynomials with a fixed Siegel disk of rotation theta; fix the star-like PCF cubic P_3 of Shishikura-Tan Lei. For non-renormalizable f_b in the boundary of the cubic Siegel connectedness locus with connected Julia set, is the formal mating f_b with P_3 realized by a cubic rational map with a fixed Siegel disk of rotation theta with no Thurston obstruction beyond ray-equivalence collapse, and do the Siegel-tree address of the free co-critical point plus the rational lamination of P_3 determine the rational map uniquely up to Mobius conjugacy; if not, what is the exact combinatorial obstruction characterizing mateability and non-uniqueness?
decisive_failure: Target requires three open theorems: infinite-type Thurston theory for Siegel matings with local connectivity of boundary Julia sets; uniform cubic Siegel renormalization bounds with controlled surgery limits; and no-invariant-line-fields rigidity for the Zakeri slice. The finite-truncation probe and moduli dimension count confirm the infinitude and the analytic-versus-discrete dimension gap, but cannot substitute for those theorems. No alternative subcase avoids them.
